library_preparation_preflight.summary: spring-boot-data-couchbase is a Spring Boot 4 split autoconfiguration module, same family as spring-boot-amqp/spring-boot-kafka which already pass in this repo with plain ApplicationContextRunner tests and no live backend, extra dependency, or Docker image.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: CouchbaseDataAutoConfiguration is @ConditionalOnBean(Cluster.class), so its beans (CouchbaseTemplate, repositories) only activate when a Cluster bean exists in the context. Follow the spring-boot-amqp/spring-boot-kafka pattern: use ApplicationContextRunner against CouchbaseDataAutoConfiguration, supplying a mocked/stub Cluster (and CouchbaseConnectionDetails/CouchbaseDataProperties as needed) rather than a real connection, to exercise properties binding, conditional activation, and customizer application without requiring network connectivity.
risks: If a later deep-coverage pass needs real repository CRUD execution (not just autoconfiguration wiring), a live Couchbase server would become necessary and no Docker image is currently allow-listed for it.
Not yet confirmed whether a lower-level spring-boot-couchbase Cluster bean is available/supported in this repo; the generated test may need to provide its own mock Cluster bean directly.

library_preparation_preflight.summary: spring-boot-data-couchbase only autoconfigures mapping/conversion beans (CouchbaseMappingContext, MappingCouchbaseConverter, CouchbaseCustomConversions) that don't require a live cluster; connection-dependent beans are gated behind @ConditionalOnBean(CouchbaseClientFactory) and simply stay inactive without one. The repo's existing Couchbase-related tests (metrics-micrometer, tracing-micrometer-observation) also run without Docker/Testcontainers, and there is no pinned Couchbase Docker image in the allow-list. The generated scaffold's ApplicationContextRunner-based test matches this pattern and needs no extra dependency, Docker image, or environment setup.
risks: Could not verify via WebFetch/WebSearch in this session (network tools were denied); conclusion rests on local repo precedent and the autoconfiguration's conditional bean structure, not a live resolved-jar inspection or upstream docs. Local Gradle/native-image verification should confirm before merge.
